g.text: UC-005 Entity Relationship Diagram — MySQL Schema (PSM)
T2: Number is PK (no separate Id since ValueObject)
ENFORCES: one caregiver per phone per shift
ENFORCES: one phone per caregiver per shift
not int (avoids magic numbers in DB)
- Guid stored as char(36) (MySQL has no native UUID)
- DateTime stored as datetime(6) for microsecond precision
- Enum stored as varchar(10) per Rule T8 (PersistedAsText)
- Migration: Create tables, indexes, FKs, seed data
There is NO direct association between Caregivers and
Phones. The relationship exists ONLY through
PhoneAssignments — this is the elevated relationship
A caregiver can have zero or more assignments over time.
A phone can have zero or more assignments over time.
But at any moment, the unique constraints ensure at most
one assignment per (caregiver, shift) and (phone, shift).
